lore: Once a revered master of elemental magic in a forgotten realm, the Invoker was drawn into the Spire by an insatiable thirst for ultimate knowledge. Now, his formidable arcane might is twisted by the Spire's influence, his spells echoing with both ancient power and dark whispers, forever seeking to master the cosmic energies that bind existence.
theme: Arcane Elemental Master, Aristocratic Sorcerer, Eldritch Scholar

appearance.body: Tall, slender, and elegant physique, with a commanding posture that conveys both age and immense power. His build is lean but suggests underlying arcane strength.
appearance.clothing: Luxurious, flowing robes of deep indigo and rich purple, adorned with intricate golden embroidery and patterns that hint at ancient magical symbols. High, ornate collar. Layers of fine fabric create a dramatic silhouette. Golden clasps and belts secure the heavy garments.
appearance.accessories: Three distinct elemental orbs (Quas: icy blue, Wex: crackling violet, Exort: fiery orange-red) perpetually orbit him, each pulsing with its unique elemental energy. Ornate golden rings on several fingers. Perhaps a subtle, glowing arcane sigil on his forehead or chest.
appearance.face: Sharp, angular features with a high nose and pronounced cheekbones. Piercing, intelligent eyes that glow faintly with arcane energy, set under thick, well-defined brows. Long, flowing white/silver hair cascades down his back and over his shoulders. A look of intense focus or subtle disdain.
appearance.silhouette: Distinctive and dramatic. The flowing robes create a wide, elegant base, tapering upwards to his broad shoulders. The long, prominent white/silver hair adds to his unique profile. The three orbiting elemental orbs are a key, instantly recognizable feature, clearly visible against the dark background.

artStyle.lighting: Dramatic lighting, emphasizing key features like his face, hands, and the glowing elemental orbs. Strong contrasts between highlights and deep shadows, creating depth and a sense of mystique.
artStyle.renderStyle: painterly, STS2 style, 2D illustration, dark fantasy

animations.name: idle
animations.description: Invoker stands tall, weight slightly forward in a confident battle stance, arms subtly raised and ready. His long white/silver hair gently sways with an imperceptible arcane current. The three elemental orbs (icy blue Quas, crackling violet Wex, fiery orange-red Exort) slowly orbit his torso in a smooth, continuous motion, each pulsing with a soft, consistent light. His eyes occasionally flicker with faint arcane energy.

animations.name: attack
animations.description: Invoker's body tenses, his weight shifting decisively forward. His right arm sweeps upward in a grand arc, gathering energy, while his left arm extends forward, palm open and fingers splayed. The three elemental orbs rapidly converge into his outstretched hand, merging into a single, intensely glowing sphere. This sphere then erupts into a powerful, focused beam or burst of arcane energy, accompanied by a specific elemental effect (e.g., a barrage of ice shards, a lightning bolt, or a fiery explosion) directed towards the viewer. After the spell is cast, his arms return swiftly to his ready stance, and the orbs reform their orbit.

animations.name: hit
animations.description: Invoker recoils sharply backward from an incoming blow, his robes rippling dramatically with the impact. His head snaps back, and a brief grimace of pain or annoyance crosses his face. One hand might instinctively rise to shield himself. The orbiting elemental orbs briefly flicker erratically or wobble out of formation before quickly stabilizing as he regains his composure and returns to his idle stance.

animations.name: death
animations.description: Invoker stumbles backward, losing his balance, his powerful posture failing. He collapses slowly to one knee, head bowed, his long hair falling forward. The arcane glow in his eyes dims and fades completely. His three elemental orbs lose their light, crackle once, and then dissipate into wisps of faint, colored smoke that vanish into the black background. His body then slumps completely to the ground, becoming still and lifeless, his robes settling around him.
